name: Over Dotfiles
description: Apply dotfiles overlays using over, a git-based files overlay manager

overlay.description: Overlay to apply without prompting or forcing conflicts (empty skips apply)

repository.description: Git source to initialize; existing checkouts are reused without pulling (empty uses a mounted repository)

overHome.description: Source repository path; ~ resolves to the lifecycle user's home

version.description: Version (tag) of the over Docker image to install from
